title: Change or correct personal details with Transport for NSW
summary: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to update your date of birth or gender on your driver licence, NSW Photo Card, or Mobility Parking Scheme permit.
intro: If you want to update your date of birth or gender on your driver licence, NSW Photo Card or Mobility Parking Scheme permit, you need to visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Individuals who want to update their date of birth or gender on their driver licence, NSW Photo Card, or Mobility Parking Scheme permit.
what_you_need: To correct the date of birth: A List 1 proof of identity document showing the correct date of birth.
For change of gender: If a replacement product (like a driver licence card) is needed, bring the relevant form.
For change of gender: If no replacement product is needed, bring the Change of Records form.

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre to request a change to your personal details. Make sure to bring the required documents with you.

internal_links.text: Change an email address or mobile number with Transport for NSW
Change of name with Transport for NSW

faqs.q: Where do I go to change my personal details?
faqs.a: You need to visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What do I need to correct my date of birth?
faqs.a: You need a List 1 proof of identity document that shows your correct date of birth.

faqs.q: What documents do I need for a gender change?
faqs.a: For a change of gender, you need one of the following: if you need a replacement product (like a driver licence card), bring the relevant form; if you do not need a replacement product, bring the Change of Records form.
